candidates.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
candidates.summary: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.

candidates.title: How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Airbnb runs evals on real engineering tasks and uses Amazon Bedrock observability to choose models for its coding agents and control production costs. This post shows how cost per task guides model selection, why production spending can differ from eval results, and how to monitor latency, manage quotas, and attribute spend.

candidates.title: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization
candidates.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT). This post explores when FFT outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examines the spectral properties of model weight matrices behind the quality gap, shares practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines, and shows how to get started.
